- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:278-380 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]

  PROBLEM: The regression test for rejecting unsafe shell constructs was dropped.
  WHY: With no CI coverage of the validation path, future weakening of shell-content filtering will pass undetected.

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The script lost its executable bit.

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Validation failures exit nonzero without saying which constraint failed.
  WHY: Operators only see a generic failure, making it harder to debug synthesis issues in workflow logs.

  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The tests rely on tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(), which can fail in restricted environments with no usable temp directory.
  WHY: Setup can error before discover_tests is exercised, causing test failures unrelated to the code under test.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:278-314 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The merge conflict resolution dropped the entire normalize_content() function, and the current file performs zero shell-content safety validation before writing generated scripts.
  WHY: Generated content such as eval, bash -c, exec, source, or exit can be written to validation/tests/synth_round_*.sh and then executed by validate_driver.sh.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:278-429 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Validation failures return a non-zero exit code without any diagnostic explaining which constraint failed.
  WHY: Operators only see a generic synthesis failure and must inspect the model output manually to determine whether it was a missing field, wrong count, or type mismatch.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:file mode 100755→100644 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The synthesis script lost its executable bit during the merge conflict resolution.
  WHY: Direct invocation with ./scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh and any tooling that expects an executable script will fail with Permission denied, even though bash scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh still works.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:330-380 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The normalize_content function that validated generated shell content for dangerous constructs was removed during merge, so the current normalization only checks JSON structure.
  WHY: Malicious or buggy model output such as eval "$PAYLOAD", exec rm -rf /, or source /tmp/payload.sh can be written to validation/tests/synth_round_*.sh and executed during validation.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:file mode 100755→100644 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script lost its executable bit.
  WHY: Direct or manual execution, or any path that relies on shebang execution, will fail with Permission denied.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~360 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When normalize_generated_items validation fails, it returns None and the script exits with code 1, but there is no diagnostic output explaining which specific constraint failed.
  WHY: Debugging validation failures requires manual inspection of the model output because no helpful error message is emitted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The script lost its executable bit during the merge.
  WHY: While the workflow invokes it via bash scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh, direct invocation and repository conventions expect the file to remain executable.

  WHY: Without this test, CI will not detect regressions in shell-content validation and future changes can reintroduce the vulnerability without automated detection.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:278-314 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The merge conflict resolution took the version that lacks normalize_content(), so shell content is no longer validated for dangerous constructs before build_wrapper writes executable scripts.
  WHY: normalize_generated_items only validates JSON structure, then validate_driver.sh runs the emitted scripts via bash, so LLM-emitted unsafe shell content can be executed without safety filtering.
